# Check: upstream tui-cell-size-input.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-cell-size-input.test.ts

## Subject
TUI handling of terminal cell-size responses at startup — ensures input is not lost when startup queries are in flight.

## Upstream test count (approx)
2

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- forwards bare escape even when a cell size query was sent at startup
- consumes cell size responses and still forwards later user input

## Upstream dependencies
getCellDimensions, resetCapabilitiesCache, setCellDimensions from ../src/terminal-image.js; Component, TUI, VirtualTerminal

## Upstream notes
Cell size response format: \\x1b[6;HEIGHT;WIDTH t. TUI queries cell size on startup when terminal supports images. setCellDimensions({widthPx, heightPx}) sets cached dimensions. getCellDimensions() returns them.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/stdin_fsm_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/tui_render_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

comments.text:
# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-cell-size-input.test.ts (2 tests — integration)
Ours: searched terminal_image_test.exs, stdin_fsm_test.exs, tui_render_test.exs, terminal_test.exs — no matching coverage.

## Analysis

Upstream verifies two invariants of the TUI runtime when it has an image-capable terminal (Ghostty in the test fixture):
1. On startup the TUI may issue a cell-size query (e.g. `\e[14t` / `\e[16t`) — a bare ESC sent by the user after startup must still be forwarded to the focused component, not swallowed into the reply parser.
2. The cell-size *response* format `\e[6;HEIGHT;WIDTHt` must be **consumed** by the TUI (not forwarded to components), must update the cached cell dimensions (getCellDimensions returns {widthPx: WIDTH, heightPx: HEIGHT}), and subsequent ordinary keystrokes ('q') must still be forwarded normally.

Upstream uses a process-env fixture (`withImageTerminal`) to force TERM_PROGRAM=ghostty and reset the capabilities cache.

## Elixir architectural divergence

apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image.ex defines `cell_dims` as a pure-function parameter with a fixed default `%{width_px: 9, height_px: 18}` — no module-level cached state, no startup query, no parser for `\e[6;H;Wt` responses. No code path in apps/octo_pi_tui queries or consumes cell-size responses.

The upstream tests therefore have no Elixir counterpart because the feature itself is unimplemented. This is not just a test gap — it's an implementation gap exposed by the audit.

## UNMAPPED

- Startup cell-size query issued on image-capable terminals (implementation)
- Parsing and consumption of `\e[6;H;Wt` responses (implementation + test)
- Non-forwarding of the response to focused components while still forwarding all other input (test)
- Cache update semantics (getter/setter equivalent) (implementation + test)
- Bare-ESC pass-through when a query is in flight (test)

## Action

Compliance ticket will flag the implementation gap first and require a decision: implement the feature (port both implementation + tests) or deliberately decline (document the N/A with justification). Either path requires ticket closure to be explicit about which was chosen.
